# The Business of You with Yolanda Butler

> Yolanda "Yo" Butler teaches entrepreneurs how to build a business around themselves, blending business strategy with mental and financial wellness.

Yolanda Butler ("Yo") is a keynote speaker, podcaster, and business strategist based in Antioch, California, serving the San Francisco Bay Area and virtual.
She has 30+ years as an entrepreneur, ran Christian Family Preschool in Oakland for 13 years, and spent 13+ years at Operation HOPE.

## The Business of You framework
1. Identify your problem
2. Build around your strengths
3. Fund and protect it
4. Sustain yourself
5. Scale your voice
